_comment: MCP SERVER CONFIG LOCATION: the server reads ~/Assistant/.mcp.json (solo/desktop) or data_root/Users/<id>/.mcp.json ONLY. A .mcp.json at the repo root is gitignored and NOT read by the server. Copy this file there, fill in placeholders, then call mcp_proxy(action='refresh'). Two shapes: HTTP (type 'http' + url + headers) and stdio (command + args). The `type` field is folded into transport explicitly; it used to be silently dropped and only worked because url was also set.
